Class WallDistrict

java.lang.Object
WallDistrict
public class WallDistrict extends Object
Represents a fortified district along Wall Rose (e.g. Trost, Krolva, Ehrmich). Handles district kill matrices, signal decoding, and titan identification.
Author:
Garrison and Wall Defense Command

    • calculateTotalConfirmedKills

      public Integer calculateTotalConfirmedKills()
      Calculates total confirmed titan kills across all sectors and squads. Traverses the 2D titanKillMatrix using nested loops. Note that some cells may be null where no squad was deployed; safely skip them.
      Returns:
      total confirmed kills as Integer

    • verifyTitanIdentification

      public boolean verifyTitanIdentification(String reportId1, String reportId2)
      Verifies whether two outpost sighting reports identify the same titan. Parses reportId1 and reportId2 to Integer. Compares the two parsed values. Hint: In Java, comparing objects using == compares memory references, like comparing whether two array variables point to the same array object. For example, comparing string or number representations like "100" and "100" might behave differently depending on how object comparison is done.
      Parameters:
      reportId1 - first titan report ID string
      reportId2 - second titan report ID string
      Returns:
      true if both IDs refer to the same titan, false otherwise

    • decodeSignal

      public int[] decodeSignal(String binarySignal, String hexSignal)
      Decodes military radio signals transmitted along the wall. Decodes binarySignal using base 2 and hexSignal using base 16.
      Parameters:
      binarySignal - urgency encoded in binary
      hexSignal - titan count encoded in hexadecimal
      Returns:
      int array [urgencyLevel, titanCount]
